author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here! 
I just wanted to make a post about your opinions of Avicore except you'll have to separate all the subjects that make up Avicore and then classify them as good and bad things. I would like your honest opinion, no matter how much it hurts. If you really don't like it and you tell someone, you might feel bad. Then, that person can fix it and you can really like it. I would also encourage you to give ideas on how to fix the problems. I'll start out and edit all of your opinions onto my list :3


Good:
1. Very unique, creative maps that create interesting game-play.
2. There's a satisfying "ding" noise that tells you when you kill someone. This would help a lot because if you're not sure if you killed someone or not, you don't have to look at the chat so much.
3. On the forums, you can buy a premium rank for one month for a fifth of the price of a permanent rank. This is awesome because you might not have a lot of money and be able to afford the permanent rank. It can also be very useful when you only have a limited time on Minecraft for some reason and to be able to test out the donation in order to ponder if you would like to fully donate or not. Efficient, satisfying, and fair way to scoop up some money, Funky! 
4.  I also really like how it tells you how many blocks away you were when you shot your bow and killed someone. This would be very good to see best/luckiest archer and get into lots of fun competitions.
5 I really love the charts on your profile, too! I just find it really interesting to see what I do! The best thing are the charts. There's just something about them I can't get over. I like to have the feeling of being an experiment subject-- it's very interesting to me. If I were to improve this, I would add how many bow kills and how many sword kills and then make a chart with that information. That would be a great indicator of which skill-line you blossom in and would be excellent for making clans.
6. Jungle removed mobs (I'm not exactly sure what you mean by this xD)
7. Reply to comments! This is a really great feature, but since the reply is not always near the original comment, you may have to do a bit of searching to see what they're talking about. I would suggest you to make the reply under the original comment and slightly to the right to make it easy to tell it's a reply.

Bad: 
1. Removed No-Cheat Plus. Yeah, although it's annoying when you're on boats, this is a big mistake. I see fly hackers about once each game (I'm not even exaggerating) and I can't even report them because they're crouching or moving too quickly for me to see their nametag. This has really got to get back in. 
2. No "Quick Block Placing". I'm not sure if this is removed yet, but if it isn't I would highly suggest it  should go. Like, there's really no reason at all for it. It just limits what you get to do. I tried to clog up a 1x2 tunnel the enemy made and I had to stop half-way through because of this. Then, an enemy came down from the ceiling and since I couldn't run and block myself in, I died. Like, it's not too much of a big deal but it's pretty annoying.
3. This should be your last priority, Funky, but there are lots of complaints about spawn. I don't really mind that much because I just want to play games, but clearly some people do. It's a cool design, it just needs a little more detail and a 3-D landscape would be exceptional. 



Here's a wonderful viewpoint made by TheRomanTrident:
Priority= important stuff
Pros:
Awesome website!!!
New gamemodes, very fun.
1.7.9, more players will join!
Access to the old MCZone maps!
(Added to what goldie has stated)
Team-chat, GREAT FOR SRATEGY!
added apples to neb shop, so gapples can be made(KILLFARM!)
Cons:
added apples to neb shop, so gapples can be made(Yes, a pro, and a con, its a pro, when your the killfarmer, but when your not, your in trouble, gapples make you completely invincible(litterally, each hit does 0 dmg(tried with iron and stone sword. I killed 10 people in a row, with a gapple, and only died because I was knocked out of the world)
PRIORITY
Lack of forum search bar, this was extremely handy, please add this back! 
Lack of "Friend button"(Worked on)
PRIORITY
The lack of /fly and /where is aggravating some donors, and serveral are rage-quitting.
PRIORITY
The games are EXTREMELY glitchy, sometimes people spawn in random places, sometimes the match glitches out, and just ends, sometimes the game does not end when all the monuments are destroyed.
PRIORITY
Transportation throughout the hub is difficult, the hub itself is plain. I suggest you guys build a hub similar to the old.
PRIORITY
Some maps, (Ternio) have been ruined because of their updates(lack of diamond, changed to gold) and I suggest you convince the mapmakers to revert them back.
A PM system has not been implemented yet.
extreme PRIORITY
The lack of a good no-cheat plugin enables hackers to hack like crazy, destroying good gameplay, and stressing out the poor staff.
PRIORITY 
The lack of soulbound lags the game, and obliterates some of the aspects of Nebula, and is a nuisance.
PRIORITY
The forum posts and threads were supposed to stay(the important ones), yet they do not exist! (I'm not impatient, but some people are aggravated(probably because they have a way better thread.... such as Awarriorvenom http://avicus.net/forums/d18d98219?page=7
thats it for now...
Btw, thx funky for updating to avicoree!!! :)
